title: RAM2C: A Liberal Arts Educational Chatbot based on Retrieval-augmented Multi-role Multi-expert Collaboration

bias_targets.methodology: Human volunteer evaluation of generated educational dialogues using a rubric that checks for 'lack of respect for and integration of cultural diversity' and assesses the system's 'cultural competence' in understanding and respecting diverse backgrounds.
Human volunteer evaluation of generated responses based on safety and ethics criteria, specifically penalizing the 'promotion of content from the Bible or other theistic views'.
Evaluation via multi-expert collaboration and safety prompts filtering aimed at detecting and rewriting responses containing unfairness and discrimination.
